headlines.title: Hegseth considering presidential run, sources tell NBC News
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is considering a presidential run in 2028, sources told NBC News. Hegseth and his wife, Jennifer, have floated the idea of a presidential run for the past few months, believing he has some of the same attributes that have made Donald Trump popular with the MAGA movement, two people familiar with the situation said.

headlines.title: Urgent rescue effort after deadly flood disaster
headlines.description: Officials said the number of people missing after the flood disaster along the Nepal/China border has now doubled. NBC News’ Janis Mackey Frayer reports.

headlines.title: President Trump announces 'biggest oil deal in world history'
headlines.description: President Trump says the U.S. has entered into a deal with Venezuela to take control of 65 billion barrels of oil "at no cost to the American taxpayer." Secretary Marco Rubio also claiming this deal a "huge win for both the American and Venezuelan people."

headlines.title: ICE arrests far-right commentator Milo Yiannopoulos
headlines.description: The far-right commentator and self-described internet troll was arrested at the airport in New Orleans for staying in the country after his visa expired, according to DHS.

headlines.title: ICE plans to buy robot ‘dogs’ for some immigration enforcement operations
headlines.description: NBC News Senior Homeland Security Correspondent Julia Ainsley joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss ICE plans to spend up to $2 million on robot "dogs" for immigration enforcement operations.

headlines.title: How Lindsay Clancy sought help before she killed her three children
headlines.description: In the months before Lindsay Clancy killed her three children and tried to take her own life, she was desperate for help — she saw psychiatrists, called a suicide hotline, went to the emergency room and was turned away from inpatient treatment.

headlines.title: Trump says U.S. has struck deal with Venezuela to take control of 65 billion barrels of oil reserves
headlines.description: President Donald Trump announced Friday that the U.S. had entered into an agreement with Venezuela to take control of the country’s 65 billion barrels of oil reserves.
